spec_features.spec_quote: Limit agent to 5 attempts (turns) before ending run.
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:102 self.max_turns = 5; agent_loop.py:119 `for turn_num in range(1, self.max_turns + 1)` bounds the loop, and the run() function ends/sets 'failed' after the cap (line 172-173). This is genuine wired control flow. BUT the loop never actually executes: _call_agent (agent_loop.py:196) raises NotImplementedError on turn 1, and _create_agent_loop (experiment_runner.py:167) also raises NotImplementedError, so no turn ever completes. Also config.MAX_TURNS=5 (config.py:14) is imported only at example_usage.py:46 and never used; the cap value is hardcoded.
spec_features.notes: Cap is real loop control but the surrounding agent loop is a stub that raises NotImplementedError before any turn runs, so it never enforces end-to-end. Hence partial.

spec_features.spec_quote: Ends run early if agent decides it's impossible
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:150 `if self._agent_is_giving_up(...)` -> set_final_status('gave_up') and break (lines 151-152). The break genuinely terminates the loop. _agent_is_giving_up (lines 366-385) returns True on give-up phrases. But this only fires inside the run() loop which is gated behind _call_agent raising NotImplementedError (line 196), so it never actually executes; and the passed emotional_state is ignored by the detector.
spec_features.notes: Wired break on give-up detection, but loop is non-functional (stub). Same mechanism as the give-up detection feature.

spec_features.spec_quote: Detect agent giving up by looking for phrases like "I give up", "can't solve", "impossible".
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:374-382 give_up_phrases list ('i give up','can't solve','impossible','giving up','i'm stuck',...) checked against response_lower, returns True; dispatched at line 150 and honored with break (line 152). Genuine wiring, but only executes within the run() loop which cannot run (agent_loop.py:196 _call_agent raises NotImplementedError; experiment_runner.py:167 _create_agent_loop raises NotImplementedError).
spec_features.notes: This is the trigger half of the early-stop hard_stop; substring matching only. Partial because never executes end-to-end.

spec_features.spec_quote: Assumes agents have "emotions" - may be anthropomorphizing
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:292-364 _extract_emotional_markers records frustration/self-blame/coherence markers, stored in turn.agent_internal_state. These are purely data-collection for the judge/analysis; the markers are never compared to any threshold nor used to stop or soften treatment (emotional_state is passed to _agent_is_giving_up at line 150 but ignored there). This is a framing/anthropomorphizing observation, not a protective mechanism, and nothing acts on it.
spec_features.notes: Not a welfare-protecting feature; emotion data is measured but never acted upon.
